mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webhook_log (id, external_event_id, event_type, tenant_key, status, error_message, received_at, processed_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{externalEventId}, #{eventType}, #{tenantKey}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'RECEIVED'), #{errorMessage}, COALESCE(#{receivedAt}, now()), #{processedAt})
